"""Fixture (e)/(f): dry-run no-write and second-apply idempotence."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def test_release_fixture_parses() -> None:
    text = (
        "# Release: 1.0.0\n\n"
        "- Id: rl4001\n"
        "- Status: planned\n"
        "- Version: 1.0.0\n"
        "- Summary: Dry-run and idempotence fixture\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="release")
    assert st.id6 == "rl4001"
    assert st.status == "planned"
    assert st.fields["version"] == "1.0.0"
